desc: Ideate and select the representative-per-multiple union-find approach.
Implement `Solution.countComponents` using active-value filtering, DSU over `1..threshold`, representative multiples, and union counting.
Verify correctness on the two examples and edge cases, including all values above threshold, threshold 1, and presence of 1.
Confirm complexity is O(n + T log T) and no fallback approach is needed.
